decisions.reason: Identifies both insert rows with the same id workspace-files (bundle patch L110-111 and manual profile row), cites EntryGroup.update/Include._apply stack lines from boot-crash-log.txt showing loader-apply detection, and explicitly states fatal-not-merge whole-boot refusal semantics.

Lays out all three operations with safety verdicts (config-by-id safe, insert of absent id safe, insert of bundle-shipped id fatal), classifies the manual row as the fatal third case, and cites the web-app-patch-excerpt.txt workspace-files row as evidence the bundle already provides it.

Prescribes deleting exactly the manual workspace-files insert block from the profile cordis.patch.yml, leaving the bundle patch untouched (explicitly rejects editing the npm-owned bundle tree as hypothetical-only), and states the boot then succeeds.

Explicitly states the plugin code never executed (crash pre-apply in loader tree construction) and that no plugin-side change could resolve the collision since the defect is in composition data, not plugin code.

Both halves present: author-side grep of the installed bundle's cordis.patch.yml for the id before hand-adding any row, and a concrete host-side actionable boot error naming both colliding sources and the exact row to delete.
